newsitem.title: USA: Affiliated Computer sells Texas-based units.
newsitem.headline: Affiliated Computer sells Texas-based units.

text.p: Affiliated Computer Services Inc said it has sold its Texas-based community bank processing units in a move to concentrate on its outsourcing and electronic funds transfer processing businesses.
The company said it decided to divest its community bank processing operations so it can focus on those services to financial institutions where it has economies of scale.
The sale of the banking groups will enable the company to focus on higher growth segments of the outsourcing market, Affiliated Computer said.
